mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM got_point WHERE status=1 AND deleted=0) AS todayTotal, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM got_record WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND DATE(check_time)=#{today}) AS todayChecked, t.* FROM ( SELECT r.id, r.point_id AS pointId, p.point_name AS pointName, p.area, r.check_time AS checkTime, r.longitude, r.latitude, r.check_status AS checkStatus, r.remark, r.img_url AS imgUrl, r.device_info AS deviceInfo FROM got_record r LEFT JOIN got_point p ON r.point_id = p.id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.check_time DESC LIMIT 5 ) t
